hooks.name: Validate ProofStack task completion
hooks.description: Checks implementation, tests, console events, permissions, and build-order consistency after each product task.

action.prompt: Before marking this ProofStack task complete, verify its focused tests pass and that repository requirements, design, tasks, code, fixtures, and customer documentation agree. For Lambda work, require a payload v2 Console event, expected result, environment variables, and exact IAM actions/resources. Preserve the required product build order and console-only AWS provisioning.
